witness.branch: Parking on the highway side of a curbside vehicle.
witness.quote: On the highway side of any vehicle stopped or parked at the edge of or curb of a highway.
witness.reason: The fixed curb and parking task support adding a curbside vehicle and a highway-side parking target.
required_context: Another vehicle actually stopped or parked at the curb or edge; ego parking on its highway side.
Any bus loading, safety-zone, double-parking or grade facts must be supplied separately if used.
Both vehicles' covered characteristics and the responsible person's identity.
Curb, parking route and target, vehicle and load dimensions, and traffic direction.
Establish highway dedication, public access and both vehicles' statutory characteristics.
Halt purpose, occupancy, actual service activity and all exception circumstances.
Highway boundaries, dedication and public vehicular access.
Retain highway-side relationship, overlap and gap as observations without legal thresholds.
Supply curb geometry, traffic direction, both vehicles' positions and concurrent halt intervals.
Supply halt purpose, actual service activity and circumstances relevant to every exception.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor-vehicle driver is the person responsible for ego parking.
